source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tropical thorn forest (PDF 241-246).

blocks.text: Yeh Pakistan ke maidanon ka sab se wasee khushki ka ecosystem hai, xerophytic (khushk saali bardasht) paudon ke saath jin ke kaante sabzi khoron ko rokte aur paani ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Tropical thorn jangal ka saada labelled manzar aur saath maloomat ka card.
blocks.caption: tropical thorn jangal: labelled khaaka aur maloomat ka card (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chapta, dhoop wala maidan aur bikhri kanton wali jhaariyan. Card mein jagah (Punjab, Sindh aur maghribi Balochistan ke Indus maidan), aab-o-hawa (khushk se neem khushk, 200-750 mm barish, garmiyon mein 50 C tak), paude (jhand, peelu ya wan, karir, kikar), janwar (oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, gidar, gerbil, sehi) aur haalat (abadiyon aur nehri kheti se bohat kharab).

blocks.caption: tropical thorn jangal ka khaaka
